name: SM_Town_Wall_Plain
sprite_frames: frames 17, 46 (blank bays between two quoin strips)
dresses: ground-floor rubble wall with dressed-stone pilasters at both ends, plinth course and an iron tie plate; jettied close-studded upper storey with a small two-light leaded window. NOTE: the class id says window, but these frames are blank bays: bind by sequence frame

name: SM_Town_Wall_Window_L
sprite_frames: frames 1, 14-16, 35-37, 40-45 (100 px bays with a lattice window)
dresses: bay with a 1.1 x 1.25 m diamond-leaded two-light window (stone sill and lintel, oak frame, iron saddle bars) and one pilaster at its left end; jettied upper storey with a raking brace. Choose L or R by the side the sprite frame has its quoin strip

name: SM_Town_Wall_Window_R
sprite_frames: frames 1, 14-16, 35-37, 40-45 (100 px bays with a lattice window)
dresses: bay with a 1.1 x 1.25 m diamond-leaded two-light window (stone sill and lintel, oak frame, iron saddle bars) and one pilaster at its right end; jettied upper storey with a raking brace. Choose L or R by the side the sprite frame has its quoin strip

name: SM_Town_Wall_Door
dresses: bay with a 1.1 x 2.1 m door opening between two pilasters, oak lintel and jambs, worn stone step 0.55 m out from the wall, a wrought-iron lantern bracket right of the door; jettied upper storey. The leaf is the separate SM_Town_Door_Studded, hinge at x = 0.73 on the back of the jamb

name: SM_Town_Wall_Narrow
dresses: 1.6 m bay with one pilaster, for corners and short returns; yaw 90 degrees for the return wall

name: SM_Town_Roof_Slope
dresses: one bay of stone-slate roof slope at 42 degrees, one closed solid 8.5 cm thick: eaves 0.42 m in front of the jetty at 4.07 m, ridge 2.76 m behind the wall line at 7.33 m; doubled eaves course, fascia, rafter feet; slipped, lifted and missing slates. Shares the wall pivot

name: SM_Town_Roof_Slope_B
sprite_frames: variant of SM_Town_Roof_Slope for the same frames
dresses: second roof bay with different slates, defects and moss, so a run of bays does not repeat: list it as a variant of SM_Town_Roof_Slope in families.json

name: SM_Town_Roof_Dormer
dresses: the roof bay with a gabled dormer standing on it: oak front with a two-light leaded window, boarded cheeks, lead apron and soakers, its own slate roof with barge boards and a lead ridge

name: SM_Town_Roof_RidgeCap
dresses: 1.5 m of ridge: lapped stone ridge tiles on a ridge board. Pivot on the ridge line at its left end; sits at z = 7.33, 2.76 m behind the front wall line

name: SM_Town_Wall_GableEnd
dresses: the whole end wall of a house, 5.51 m between the long-wall centre lines: stone plinth, pegged box frame with St Andrew's crosses and a leaded window, jettied upper frame, tie beam, gable triangle with king post, collar and struts (the roof verge over it is SM_Town_Roof_Verge, placed at the same point). Bind ONE per house end (the sprite is a 92 px slice of the same wall): left end of a row at (0, 5.51, 0) yaw -90, right end at (row length, 0, 0) yaw +90

name: SM_Town_Roof_Verge
sprite_frames: the shingled verge drawn at the top of frames 7, 10, 24
dresses: roof verge for a gable end: 0.56 m strips of both slopes oversailing the wall by 0.3 m, barge boards with capping fillets and a finial post. Place at the same point and yaw as SM_Town_Wall_GableEnd

name: SM_Town_Corner_Quoin
sprite_frames: the pale quoin strip at the outer corner of frames 2, 11, 18, 19
dresses: outer corner of two stone bay rows: alternating long and short dressed quoins, jetty corner post on a dragon bracket. Not family-bound: place where two rows meet at a right angle (pivot on the meeting point of the wall centre lines, faces toward -X and -Y)

name: SM_Town_Chimney_Stack
sprite_frames: no sprite frame in family 33 (the town roofs show no stack); family 63 chimney_stone frame 13 (61x187 px) is the same object
dresses: external stone chimney stack, 7.6 m to the cap plus pots: battered base, two weathered offsets, drip course, cap slab, two sooted clay pots. Stands against a gable end or long wall (pivot at the centre of its back face on the ground)

name: SM_Town_Door_Studded
sprite_frames: the door drawn inside the town_wall_stone_door frames
dresses: studded door leaf of seven separate oak planks, 1.04 x 2.04 m, ledges, strap hinges, 48 iron studs and a ring pull. Pivot on the hinge edge. Not family-bound: place in each Wall_Door opening
